name: What does 'walk-in tub installation coordination' entail for a general contractor?

mainEntity.name: What does 'walk-in tub installation coordination' entail for a general contractor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Walk-in tub installation coordination involves managing all aspects of the project from start to finish. This includes assessing your home's plumbing and electrical systems, ensuring structural integrity, obtaining necessary permits, and scheduling and overseeing qualified tradespeople like plumbers, electricians, and tilers. A general contractor acts as your single point of contact, streamlining communication and ensuring the project adheres to local building codes and safety standards. This comprehensive approach minimizes disruption and ensures a smooth, efficient installation process for your new walk-in tub.
acceptedAnswer.description: It involves managing the entire installation project, from assessment and permits to scheduling trades and overseeing work, ensuring compliance with local codes.
